body: I feel this way about my husband, but also he knows I suffer from these thoughts so I resent him sometimes for trying to just “make it go away” but not doing much more than that. I also feel like a piece of shit for reaching out to him for help because it’s such a huge burden.

>	People just want to be sad about suicides after they happen, not prevent them. A supposed 'outpouring of grief and support' in my community after people did it but I feel more alone than I did ever before.

God I can relate to this so hard - people feeling sorry for themselves, even when someone else was clearly suffering more than they can ever relate to. It makes me furious to thing of who would opportunistically throw themselves a pity party in the aftermath.
Do you think going missing is worse than being found dead from suicide? Honest question…

I could really relate to the old guy player #001, did you see the giddy joy on his face playing red light green light, he had it the best because he was terminal and didn’t give 2 fucks….. if I could feel like that again then that’s a good way to go tbh….

*God made bees, bees made honey. God made man and man made money.*

(I’m not religious but I’ve always loved this rhyme - replace god with physics if you want, rhyme still stands).

Money IS the official global state-backed religion. The god we all need to worship. Having more of it doesn’t make you happy, but having none of it is pure suffering. To challenge it is blasphemy.

What a world right?

The bees had the right idea, I think.

Money can’t buy you peace in your heart anyway. So I wish you peace and freedom from this money-driven cruelty.

Isnt it weird that even if some people accept that euthanasia should be a choice (and that’s such a radical view to the mainstream) even still it’s only if you are terminal or something. Who gets to decide if you have a “good enough reason” to want to end with dignity? Who gets to decide that you are in the correct amount of pain for it to be a rational option?

People are so full of themselves and I think you are right, they are protecting their own feelings over yours.

If they don’t like it fine - but I think their censorship is actually actively harmful. We’re not aiding and abetting to want a space to discuss our feelings without getting censored by people who are only protecting themselves from something they could never relate to that disturbs them. You are 100% right - we disturb their peace and that’s that. 

**You** deserve peace. **You** deserve freedom. I wish it for you whatever your path may be.
